summary: The actual S_TOUCH graph implies one of the three stated complete A9/B9 rows after a simultaneous template-preserving relabeling. No proof issue found; same-family provisional review only.

scope.theorem: Every actual order-62 graph already satisfying S_TOUCH, with its exact simple repeat matrix, has a simultaneous template-preserving relabeling giving one of the three complete canonical A9/B9 rows.
explicit_template_assumptions: the only edge among root neighbors is 12
all other Y vertices have one parent

typed_symbols.A: symmetric zero-diagonal 62 by 62 adjacency matrix over {0,1}
typed_symbols.B: exact matrix A^2+A-7I-J, simple symmetric zero-diagonal, row sum 3
typed_symbols.C_i: disjoint singleton-parent vertex classes for i=1,...,8
typed_symbols.n_i: integer cardinality of N_G(9) intersect C_i
typed_symbols.c(x,y): integer common-neighbor count for distinct vertices

obligations.claim: Exact inherited identities and S_TOUCH template hypotheses
AB=BA at (1,9) forces B_29=0 and B_9,C1=0
AB=BA at (1,y) forces B_9y=0 on C4 through C8
Exactly six Y-neighbors, none in C1, at least one in C4 through C8
The sixth neighbor cannot lie in C2 because B_92=n2=0
A selected C3 point forces the complete case A row
The doubled-class case has the exact root common counts and remaining B neighbor in unused C2 or C3
All three row patterns have a compatible simultaneous template-preserving canonical relabeling
Canonical labels match the archived JSON and determine complete rows including all zeros

counterexample_attempts.resolution: Forces B_92=1 contrary to AB row 1 saturation

counterexample_attempts.candidate: Missing class among C4 through C8 or multiple extras
counterexample_attempts.resolution: Violates diameter two or the six-neighbor degree budget

counterexample_attempts.candidate: Different B support in case A
counterexample_attempts.resolution: The triangle and root already saturate row 9

counterexample_attempts.candidate: Remaining B neighbor outside C2 or C3 in doubled-class case
counterexample_attempts.resolution: Excluded by exact common counts, zero diagonal, or row 1 commutation

counterexample_attempts.candidate: Canonical A and B assignments collide
counterexample_attempts.resolution: Shared point moves once in A; B point lies in an unused A class in C2/C3

direct_check.method: Python loaded the archived S_TOUCH JSON, assembled known template edges and the proposed complete A9 rows, and recomputed common counts with 0 through 8.
direct_check.scope_limit: Only template labels and forced common counts were checked computationally; the remaining Y repeat entries rely on the discharged proof obligations.

remaining_external_obligations: certified branch contradictions or replacement mathematics
